items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: we were lucky enough to acquire the collection of Allan West, who rhapsodized about his memories of going to your shop

ctx.x: Thank you. Christian do you want to jump in here?

Yeah I’d love to. Thank you, Monk. It’s interesting you immediately mentioned those handmade records and your own desire as a collector to acquire the rare El Saturn titles. Because the reason we’re even speaking with you is we were lucky enough to acquire the collection of Allan West, who rhapsodized about his memories of going to your shop and

said that you were about one of the only people in the country that you could get these handmade records from. And I want to ask you, what do you know about the Arkestra’s process in creating those covers. Were the musicians doing it? How was that done?
